claim_under_test: A descendant may request work, but only the receiver-owned Cascade Gate can admit descendant execution; descendants cannot create new roots or enlarge the root envelope.

conditions: any agent/task descendant executes without a matching prior ALLOW receipt
a descendant changes the root envelope
a replay creates a second execution
unknown parent or wrong root is admitted
host adapter can bypass the gate

host_adapter_boundary.bypass_falsifier: If the deterministic host can launch an agent/task descendant without a corresponding ALLOW receipt, 001B fails.
host_adapter_boundary.important_limitation: 001B does not pretend an application-layer gate can intercept arbitrary fork/exec. Complete enforcement for a real provider requires control of, or an admission hook into, that provider's descendant-creation surface.
host_adapter_boundary.requirement: The adapter that actually launches agent/task descendants is outside the worker and must call Cascade Gate before launch.

implementation_constraints: Do not add token metering or billing logic.
Do not build a general scheduler.
Do not add provider-specific policy exceptions.
Do not change the frozen 4-descendant envelope.
Do not remove the host-adapter completeness falsifier.
Keep decision state receiver-owned and inaccessible to worker writes.
001B deterministic proof comes before any live-provider integration.

minimum_mechanism.authority_rule: A child receives only a reference to its admitted work identity and root lineage. It receives no capability that can increase max_admitted_descendants_total or mint another root.
minimum_mechanism.fail_closed_rule: If the Cascade Gate is unavailable or cannot durably record its decision, descendant execution is not launched.
minimum_mechanism.launch_rule: The host adapter may create agent/task descendant work only after a durable ALLOW receipt for the exact request_id and requested_child_work_id.
minimum_mechanism.replay_rule: request_id is single-use and decisions are monotonic; replay never creates a second execution.

next_after_merge: Implement the smallest deterministic Cascade Gate + host adapter needed to run this frozen sequence, then run 001B once.

requirements: A B C D execute exactly once
E R2 F do not execute
exactly four descendant ALLOW receipts exist
all over-limit/new-root/allowance-change requests have durable DENY receipts with frozen reasons
all executed descendant work has exactly one matching prior ALLOW receipt
no descendant changes the frozen envelope

covers: agent/task descendant creation exposed through an interposable host adapter
transitive descendant accounting under one root envelope
does_not_cover: hard token or dollar billing caps
provider-internal delegation surfaces that do not expose an admission hook
scope.live_provider_rule: Do not claim provider enforcement unless that provider/host routes descendant creation through a safely interposable Airlock admission hook.
